prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 11 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, bright soft daylight from the windows behind the desk.

Image 12: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 13: the prop small dumbbell; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran sits upright in the one black leather executive chair behind the one walnut desk. Her back is to the floor-to-ceiling windows, and she faces the open space in front of the desk. She wears the crimson sleeveless bodycon sheath dress. The desk holds architectural plans, wood samples and a metal figurine. The four applicants stand in one row in the open space in front of the desk, facing her. From the lounge end of the room they stand in this order: GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, who holds the small dumbbell at his side, then BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, then GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, then SHIRTLESS APPLICANT in his black T-shirt. Xu Banxia walks from the black leather sofas and the white marble coffee table of the lounge area toward the lounge end of the desk. The office door is in the wall facing the desk. It stands open and empty. The axis runs from the desk to the door wall, and the camera stays on the lounge side of it.
Panel 1: Wide shot, slow push in, eye-level, from the lounge side of the room. The desk is at frame right and the row of applicants is at frame left. Xu Banxia walks past the marble coffee table to the lounge end of the walnut desk and bends slightly toward Ji Ran. Ji Ran sits in the leather executive chair, and the four applicants stand in a row in front of the desk.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side. Ji Ran leans back in the leather chair with her long legs crossed. Her eyes sweep coolly along the row of men.
Panel 3: Medium shot, quick push in, low angle, from the lounge side. GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, at the lounge end of the row, straightens his back and grins eagerly. The small dumbbell hangs in his hand.
Panel 4: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side. Ji Ran's gaze slides one place along the row, and she taps one finger on the walnut desk.
Panel 5: Medium shot, handheld, eye-level, from the lounge side. BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, second in the row, puffs out his chest and plants his fists on his hips.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, slight push in, high angle, from the lounge side. Ji Ran raises one eyebrow and rests her chin on her hand.
Panel 7: Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle, from the lounge side. GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, third in the row, smugly pats his stomach through the tight grey T-shirt.
Panel 8: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side. Ji Ran presses her glossy lips together to hold back a smile, and the corner of her mouth twitches.
Panel 9: Medium close-up, quick push in, eye-level, from the lounge side. Ji Ran leans forward over the walnut desk with her forearms on the plans and looks straight at the row.
Panel 10: Wide shot, fast pan along the row from the lounge end to the far end, eye-level, from the lounge side. The four applicants start with wide eyes and nod frantically one after another, from GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT to SHIRTLESS APPLICANT, as the chorus is heard.
Panel 11: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side. Ji Ran sits back in the leather chair and lifts one hand in a lazy go-ahead gesture.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
